name: extensive-carrier-scale-inversion-probe
description: Inverts the qou-n4zp alpha-cluster exclusion into an energy-scale requirement (E_req = T / L) and compares it against every energy scale the corpus carries. Records that qou-n4zp's percentages are conditional on E_0 and that the exclusion is scope (a), not (b).

scales.note: my own earlier outlier (qou-59j5); no reason was given
CAL-1 — a calibration, not a derivation
the unit SaturationPeakStructure states a_V in

verdict: SCOPE (a). Closing one alpha in the trace channel requires E >= 12.372 MeV = 2.956 x E_0; closing the bulk requires 26.175 MeV = 6.253 x E_0. No live corpus energy scale reaches either — the largest, hbar_q^2*m_N = 9.218 MeV, is 1.34x short of one alpha and 2.84x short of the bulk. The exclusion therefore survives every scale the corpus carries, but a larger scale would close it, so this is a scope-limited negative and NOT a structural exclusion. qou-n4zp's 20.6-33.8 % and 9.8-16.0 % are E_0 figures and must be quoted with the scale named (bean qou-59j5). No energy scale is derived here; that item stays open.

assertions.name: closing one alpha needs an energy scale strictly above E_0
assertions.detail: E_req = 12.371928 MeV = 2.95556 x E_0. The requirement is a scale, not a ratio — this statement is independent of which scale is chosen, which the 20.6-33.8 % figures in qou-n4zp are not.

assertions.name: NO live corpus energy scale closes even one alpha
assertions.detail: none of m_e, E_0, hbar_q^2*m_N reaches 12.371928 MeV. The largest live scale is hbar_q^2*m_N = 9.2175404 MeV, still 1.34222x short of one alpha and 2.83973x short of the bulk. The only scale that would close it is the excised m_p/tr_M(proton), which overshoots by 134.395x.

assertions.name: the supplied fraction scales EXACTLY linearly with the energy (so the percentages are scale-conditional)
assertions.detail: |frac(hq2)/frac(E_0) - hq2/E_0| = 0.0. B_trace = E x L has no other E-dependence, so every percentage in qou-n4zp moves by the scale ratio 2.2020023 and none of them is a scale-free measurement.

assertions.name: the exclusion nonetheless SURVIVES the largest live scale
assertions.detail: at hbar_q^2*m_N the complete graph supplies 74.5 % of one alpha and 35.21 % of the bulk — larger than the E_0 figures by 2.202x, and still short. So the DIRECTION of qou-n4zp is robust across the live scales even though its NUMBERS are not scale-free.
